items.title: Earl Foster Interview
items.q: he came and played with the band. And Toma Ladner too.

ctx.x: Oh, yes. This clarinet player, Fritz. Is it or Fritz, yeah. Is it or Fritz? It's the only clarinet player that I know over there. Back from the times. Mm-hmm. It's the only the independent band. Yeah. But this boy, I think about from Slido, he's on the park, well, he came and played with the band. And Toma Ladner too. Toma Ladner too. Yeah.
But how long you stayed at Alamo with Kaiser?
